manifest.description: Parses competitive programming problems and sends them to C++ Here.

errors.parserFailed: Something went wrong while running C++ Here's {{parser}}. Open the browser console to see the error. If you think this is a bug, please open an issue at {{url}} and include a link to this page.
errors.noParser: C++ Here could not determine which parser to parse this page with. Please right-click on the extension icon and select the parser to use via the "Parse with" context menu. If you think this page should be supported, please open an issue at {{url}}.
errors.sendFailed: C++ Here could not send this problem to the editor. {{message}}
errors.parseFailed: C++ Here could not parse this page. {{message}}
errors.tabClosed: The C++ Here tab was closed before it finished loading.
errors.tabTimeout: The C++ Here tab did not finish loading within {{seconds}} seconds.
errors.editorRejected: The C++ Here editor did not accept the problem data. Try reloading the editor tab.
errors.editorNotReady: The C++ Here editor was not ready within {{seconds}} seconds. Make sure the editor tab has finished loading and try again.
errors.dispatchFailed: Could not send the problem data to the C++ Here editor tab.
errors.targetUrlSetting: {{error}} Change the target URL in the C++ Here extension options.
errors.accessDenied: C++ Here needs access to {{origins}} to send problems to the editor. Click the button again and allow access.
errors.noTargetAccess: C++ Here doesn't have access to {{url}}. Click the button again and allow access.
errors.noRequestPermission: C++ Here does not have permission to request {{url}}

targetUrl.badProtocol: The target URL must start with http:// or https://.
targetUrl.hasQuery: The target URL cannot contain a query string (?) or a fragment (#).
targetUrl.badWildcard: The target URL can only contain * at the end.
targetUrl.hostNotAllowed: C++ Here can't be given access to {{host}}. The target URL must be on https://cpp.doong.me, a local dev server on localhost or 127.0.0.1 (any port), or a preview deployment on *.cpp-insiders.doong.me.

options.title: C++ Here Options
options.targetUrlDescription: The C++ Here editor that parsed problems are sent to. Only change this to test a local dev server (any port on {{localhost}} or {{loopback}}) or a preview deployment on {{previewHost}}.
options.customRulesDescription: Use a specific parser for pages whose URL matches a regular expression, instead of the parser C++ Here picks automatically.
options.invalidRegex: The following regular expression is invalid: {{expression}}
options.invalidRegexes: The following regular expressions are invalid: {{expressions}}
options.debugModeDescription: Also log the parsed problem data to the console of the problem page.
